Before you start

What is Studios.Bit?

A digital solutions, marketing and social media agency for businesses that need to explain their offer and make it easy to get in touch.

When should I choose a landing page or a corporate website?

A landing page focuses on one offer and action. A corporate site gives each service its own page.

How much does a website cost and how is it estimated?

Landing pages start at MXN 6,900 and corporate websites at MXN 13,900. Adjust structure, languages and extras in the estimator, then request a scope review.

What does social media management include?

Planning, design, writing, scheduling and reporting. Channels, content volume and reels depend on the plan. On-site production, advertising and intensive inbox management require a separate scope.

How do I book and what should I prepare?

Book a web consultation through Setmore. Bring your goals, offer, available assets and desired timing.
